description: All-in-one MongoDB + Replica Set + Database Activity overview.

options.content:
**MongoDB & Replica Set — Full Overview**

Covers node/replica-set health, replication lag and sync status, per-database read/write activity, operations, and resource usage (memory, WiredTiger cache, connections).

Built for the Percona `mongodb_exporter` running with `--compatible-mode` and the `replicasetstatus`, `dbstats`, `topmetrics`, `indexstats`, and `diagnosticdata` collectors enabled. After importing, select your Prometheus data source and set the **Instance** variable at the top to your target host.
